summary: Public first-party NC3 program-source recovery is partial: NAVAIR HTML program pages and the E-130J award records are now preserved, while the detailed Air Force SAOC volume, Navy BA5 TACAMO book, and AFGSCMD 63-101 remain unrecovered because current first-party retrieval paths fail or stall.
referenced_by: FY2026 DoD/Navy budget indexes; 2025-2026 USSTRATCOM posture statements; Air Force e-Publishing index; preserved NAVAIR/Navy/DoD E-130J program and award records
last_known_location: Air Force e-Publishing; SAF/FM FY2026 RDT&E Volume II; Department of the Navy FY2026 RDT&E BA5 budget book
known_creator: Department of the Air Force / Department of the Navy / NAVAIR
likely_custodian: AFGSC / SAF-FM / Department of the Navy FMB / NAVAIR
stated_reason_missing: The remaining sources are public or publicly indexed. Current gaps are first-party transport/retrieval failures, not evidence that the records do not exist.
potential_relevance: Would deepen source genealogy beneath high-level NC3 posture statements for the NC3 Center, SAOC, and TACAMO/E-130J programs without relying on platform operating procedures.
